# Appendix map

| Appendix | Purpose | Main-text consumers |
|---|---|---|
| A — Oriented conditional kernel | Handles both link orientations, cyclic conjugacy, normalization, continuity, and gauge-invariance of the event. | Proposition 3.3 |
| B — Product heat-kernel Laplace bounds | Proves normalized setwise LDP and parameter-uniform energy-gap estimate. | Lemma 3.4, Theorems 3.6 and 4.1 |
| C — Exact incidence certificate | States the identity minor and documents the independent GF(2) verifier. | Proposition 3.2 |
| D — Hostile-case ledger | Records cut-locus, threshold, trivial-center, low-dimensional, gauge, and global-twist cases. | Sections 5 and 7 |
| E — Reproducibility and claim status | Separates analytic proof from exact computation and supplies commands/data statement. | Submission and referee audit |

All theorem hypotheses and decisive mechanisms remain in the main text. No appendix introduces a new assumption.
